藏品名称_EN: visiting a friend in the mountains
描述_EN: the work is spuriously signed at the bottom right hand corner by li zhaodao (active during the tang dynasty, about ad 670-730) and bears suprious seals and inscriptions of some important connoisseurs, like ke jusi (1290-1343) and wen zhengming (1470-1559). ming collectors were likely to pay more attention to the authenticating inscriptions and seals on the painting rather than its style, and the forger probably took more care in imitating them than a real tang work. it depicts a gentleman accompanied by his servant approaching a cottage in the mountains to pay a visit to a friend. this large scale hanging scroll was probably painted in the second half of the 16th century or the first half of the 17th century at the end of the ming dynasty (1368-1644). the painting is clearly a product of the ming dynasty and the artist did not make any attempts to imitate a tang dynasty style.
描述_ZN: 该作品右下角有李昭道（活跃于唐代，约公元670-730年）的假签名，并有一些重要鉴赏家的印章和题词，如柯九思（1290-1343）和文征明（1470-1559）。 明朝的收藏家很可能更关注画上的鉴定铭文和印章，而不是它的风格，伪造者在模仿它们时可能比真正的唐代作品更谨慎。 它描绘了一位绅士在仆人的陪同下走近山中的小屋去拜访一位朋友。 这幅大型挂画可能是在16世纪下半叶或17世纪上半叶，在明朝末年（1368-1644）绘制的。 这幅画显然是明代的产物，画家没有试图模仿唐代的风格。
